scheme_name: Incentive To Saharia Students For B.Ed
other_conditions: Student must be a native of Rajasthan
Student must belong to the Saharia class, a tribe of Baran district, Rajasthan
Student must be a regular trainee in a government or non‑government B.Ed training institute
Student's mother, father, guardian, or guardian should not be a taxpayer
Students residing in a government‑run hostel are not eligible for the scheme
Student must possess a Vaidya Bhamashah card and Aadhaar
benefits_summary: Eligible Saharia tribe students pursuing regular B.Ed training receive up to Rs.30,000 per year (covering college fees, books, house rent, food, and clothing).
